findings.summary: Standardization inside build_features computes mean/std over the full dataset before the train/test split, leaking test statistics into training features and making test AUC optimistic.

Scaling parameters are not saved, so at inference build_features standardizes with the input batch's own statistics; a single row gives NaN std (all numeric features NaN) and small batches are scaled differently from training, producing wrong predictions.
A constant column has std of 0, causing division by zero and NaN or inf feature values.
